attestations.text: I-liang 怡良 (H. 悅亭), Oct. 18, 1791–1867 (1863?), official, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a member of the Gulgiya clan (瓜爾佳氏). His father, Wên-tê 文德 (H. 修園), became acting lieutenant-governor of Kansu, and his wife was a descendant of Dodo [q. v.].
怡良，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 怡良，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人。刑部筆帖式，洊升員外郎。道光八年，出為廣東高州知府，調廣西南寧。歷雲南鹽法道，山東鹽運使，安徽、江蘇按察使，江西、江蘇布政使。
